evidence.section: 1. Introduction
evidence.quote: Generally, one can expect screw-dislocation mobility to dictate yield strength in BCC alloys [17,18], however, it has been recently shown that in MPEAs with high atomic-size mismatch (i.e., where the radii of the elemental constituents differ signiﬁcantly), edge-dislocation mobility can become greatly restricted, allowing it to overtake screw-dislocation mobility as the limiting factor in the yield strength.
